title: The Cosmic Entropy Budget as Constraint on the EFC S-Field
abstract: This working note argues that the observed cosmic entropy budget—overwhelmingly dominated by supermassive black holes (SMBHs)—is structurally consistent with Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC). It maps Bekenstein–Hawking entropy to the EFC S-field normalization, places SMBHs at S = S_max (grid-collapse boundary) while the CMB approaches S_max from the thermal side, and proposes that the decline of AGN accretion drives the sigmoid transition in S(z) near z ~ 1.
